title: Ground Telemetry
description: Data payload for msg_type 'telemetry'. Carries real-time telemetry from a ground vehicle or asset, covering position, motion, powertrain, and extensible custom fields.

entity_id.description: Unique identifier for the ground entity (e.g. 'vehicle-alpha-1', 'ugv-007').

speed_ms.description: Current speed in metres per second. Null if not available.

heading_deg.description: Current heading in degrees (0-360, clockwise from North). Null if not available.

lat.description: Latitude in decimal degrees (WGS-84). Null if not available.

lon.description: Longitude in decimal degrees (WGS-84). Null if not available.

alt_m.description: Altitude above mean sea level in metres. Null if not available.

rpm.description: Engine or motor revolutions per minute. Null if not available.

fuel_pct.description: Fuel level as a percentage (0-100%). Null if not available.

odometer_km.description: Total odometer reading in kilometres. Null if not available.

engine_temp_c.description: Engine coolant or core temperature in degrees Celsius. Null if not available.

battery_v.description: Main battery or electrical system voltage in volts. Null if not available.

custom.description: Extensible map of vendor- or platform-specific telemetry fields. Null if not used.
